description: 书童 Pagekin（原名 AI 小说作家）：开源免费的 AI 长篇小说写作桌面软件，从设定、蓝图到正文、审稿、定稿；支持拆解仿写、续写、改写，可导入写作 Skill（如去 AI 味）。模型需自行配置，作品在本地。Pagekin (formerly AI Novel Writer): free, open-source AI novel writing app for long novels and web fiction. Imitate, continue, rewrite; import writing skills. Local-first, no model bundled. Windows & macOS.
